images.title: Plan an investigation in four steps
images.purpose: Shows the plan of a data investigation: ask, collect, summarise, show, with one worked number.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Four rounded boxes in one row, joined left to right by three arrows.
images.exact_structure: Four equal rounded boxes in one horizontal row joined by three dark arrows pointing right. Box 1, teal (#0072B2) outline: Ask, with How long outdoors? under it. Box 2, amber (#E69F00) outline: Collect, with 1.5, 2, 1 hours under it. Box 3, reddish purple (#CC79A7) outline: Summarise, with mean 1.5 h under it. Box 4, teal outline: Show, with a small strip of 6 boxes drawn inside it, the first 3 filled teal, and 3 boxes written under it.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A data investigation goes question, collect, summarise, show.
images.description: Shows the plan of a data investigation: ask, collect, summarise, show, with one worked number.
images.context: Outdoors 1.5, 2 and 1 hours over 3 days: total 4.5, mean 1.5 hours, which is 3 half hour boxes.

image_decisions.why: A four step plan gives the project its shape before any data is collected.
